transcript.text: Thank you, Jonas. Now for my logistics and reefer-log findings. I reviewed the carrier reefer log today, and it shows that the 520 seals that passed inspection experienced temperature exposure during transit. As a result, they remain usable only through 2026-07-18. This is a critical constraint for the disposition decision — the seals have a shortened shelf life compared to what we would normally expect. I should also note that I have not yet uploaded the reefer-log attachment to the receiving record, so I'm flagging that as an open item we need to close out before finalizing disposition.

This is a hard stop from a regulatory compliance standpoint — regardless of the other findings, we cannot release these seals to production without that signed Certificate of Conformance on file in the lot record.

Thank you all for your thorough reports. Let me summarize what we have on the table before I make my disposition decision.

From Jonas (quality): 80 of the 600 seals are nonconforming due to swelling and must be rejected. The remaining 520 passed visual and dimensional checks. Quality sign-off has not yet been entered in the receiving system — that's an open item.

From Priya (logistics): The 520 conforming seals experienced temperature exposure during transit, shortening their usable shelf life to 2026-07-18. The reefer-log attachment has not yet been uploaded to the receiving record — another open item.

From Tomas (regulatory compliance): A signed Certificate of Conformance must be attached to the lot record before any seals can be released to production. This is a hard stop. Additionally, this requirement is not yet on our plant's release checklist, so we need to address that gap.

So here's where we stand: 80 seals are rejected for nonconformance. The 520 conforming seals cannot be released to production until three open items are closed — (1) Jonas enters the quality sign-off in the receiving system, (2) Priya uploads the reefer-log attachment to the receiving record, and (3) a signed Certificate of Conformance is attached to the lot record. The 520 seals, once released, will have a use-by date of 2026-07-18.

Before I formalize the disposition, does anyone have anything else to add or any corrections to what I've summarized?
